title: Certify QQ16's first nonterminal C8 band and internal parking term
body:
#4177's complete QQ16 cost exclusion applies to terminal C8 children. This package resolves its first nonterminal source-tree boundary: in the retained `p=2^8500` RootPlan family, exactly **45≤λ≤72** gives one generation of selected-C children below each removed C8, while every added C1 and every grandchild is terminal. The global strict cutoff is at width 356. At λ=45 the source tests width 360, strips a 68-axis remainder, then executes the selected program at width 292 without repeating that cutoff.

The independent data-only census consumes both complete local words, all 482 source events and every idle suffix. It corroborates the prior 510,662Γ child count and applies it to the new boundary: sixteen removed C8 calls per outer cover contain **8,170,592Γ² internal parking pairs**. The actual B* adapter replaces only the outer controller and retains the original Machine as its child; its adoption option does not recursively remove those pairs. That callgraph is bound to the exact retained adapter bytes.

Each grandchild has physical volume `v/(14336Γ)`, but every parked C8 current bank still has volume `v`. The literal park loop alone gives a removed R/W/unit-move lower term `(16,341,184,40,852,960,40,852,960)Γ²v`. The complete symbolic bill retains remainder execution, child preparation/return, scalar/bank work, native/Ordinary internals and candidate costs. **The full cost sign, supplier admission and a new κ are not established.** This is a new source-tree/partial-cost result, not another terminal exclusion or generic parking optimisation.

Validation on macOS arm64 / Python 3.12.2:

- Registered normal and optimized replays pass, including exact RootPlan/stock/volume arithmetic, all event rows, source callgraph/order checks and ten rejecting controls.
- Separate read-only Codex review checked the actual Machine/BankPackets/Parking/RootPlan sources, root-only adapter boundary, stock/volume and cutoff argument without finding a blocker; this is not human or proof-kernel acceptance.
- Twenty committed package/input files pass source-history and byte preflight, depending only on canonical main `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`.
- Official committed export check and Git-free normal/optimized replays pass. Source corruption and a boolean/integer receipt mutation reject; all 21 export files are restored byte-identically.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-nonterminal-c8-tree`.

Only the new six-file package changes. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744) records scope and entry overlap. Huge production payloads, full RootLayer/C8 execution, native-internal prices, Lean/Docker and hosted CI are not claimed.

Credit Chris R / Clear1nsight's #4166/#4167/#4172/#4177; Jose Manuel's physical C/Ordinary/Compact source; ywz65, Sagar Thakrar, Tekalign, Ali Romman, Arham Tahir and the retained source lineage. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Scoped search and live predecessor heads were rechecked; no competing result was identified in this stated coverage. Closed PR diffs, arbitrary nested code and unpublished work remain outside it.
